# Azumi’s right-arm injury performance

Azumi performed **accident-05-damage right arm** for mocapdata.com, Eyes, JAPAN Co. Ltd., © 2008–2009. The full BVH was converted to Humanoid FBX. The game uses seconds 25.12–26.69, retargeted to each archer, mirrored for the left arm and fitted for boot and forearm contact. The source and adapted motion clips retain the publisher’s Attribution–ShareAlike terms. The character models have separate licenses.
